reset_world_state: reset the World class to reinitialize all cached object IDs, regions, and articulated object links on scene change
update_world_state: update the World state each frame by advancing the object state machine and refreshing the state snapshot dictionary
get_object_states: get all object states for a given object handle and return a list of ObjectStateInfo with specs and values
lookup_object_handle: lookup an object by handle to get its ID or by ID to get its handle using the World mapping caches
get_object_region: get the primary semantic region containing most of a rigid or articulated object using the World helper method
